verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents and demonstrates project-local install: `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project's `.agents/skills` and `.claude/skills` directories, and the docs say those files can be committed to share the setup with the team. There is no evidence of a user-global skill or instruction scope, or of any option to choose between scopes. The `npm install -g` command installs only the CLI binary through npm, which is a host-platform mechanism rather than an Ultrametric scope choice. missing for 10: a documented user-global install scope for skills/instructions, an explicit flag or option to choose between project-local and user-global, independent corroboration of scope selection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
